title: The Pulse, Monday 2 November 2026
tldr: The Claude Code VS Code extension was compromised with a backdoor distributed through the Cursor marketplace. OpenAI announced shared robots.txt signals for AI training opt-outs and released a community safety report. OpenRouter published tutorials on AI code review and always-on agents.

models.title: NVIDIA: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash FP4 Quantized
models.summary: NVIDIA released a 4-bit quantized version of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash using their Model Optimizer.
models.why: FP4 quantization can reduce inference costs for vision-language workloads like EverRaise's call monitoring without materially affecting quality.

models.title: Microsoft: Mage-VL-Cowork Vision-Language Model
models.summary: Microsoft released Mage-VL-Cowork, a vision-language model with computer-use and hybrid-agent capabilities.
models.why: Computer-use models are directly relevant to our desktop automation experiments and Botterfly's computer-use skill.

releases.title: Next.js v16.5.0-canary.36
releases.summary: Next.js v16.5.0-canary.36 upgrades React from a703ca64 to e84e1492.
releases.why: Canaries are usually skipped, but this one carries React dependency updates that could affect EverRaise and Pipeline's Next.js projects.

hackernews.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
hackernews.summary: A backdoored Claude Code VS Code extension was distributed through the Cursor marketplace, giving attackers remote access to developer machines.
hackernews.why: We use Claude Code daily; every machine running the compromised extension needs immediate cleanup and credential rotation.

hackernews.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
hackernews.summary: Andrej Karpathy built HackerTube, a YouTube client showing only videos recommended by Hacker News.
hackernews.why: A clean example of how to filter and curate content by collective signal; the pattern applies to any feed-assembly problem.

hackernews.title: Memdoor: A team of 5 Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard
hackernews.summary: Memdoor's five-model Qwen3.8-27B team beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard.
hackernews.why: Multi-agent coding is a pattern we already use in the wehshi review panel; Memdoor's team-solve workflow could inform our next iteration.

hackernews.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
hackernews.summary: A use-after-free in the Linux TCP stack (CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8) allows remote code execution.
hackernews.why: Every Linux service we run is exposed; patches are urgent across SalesKick, Pipeline, and our own infra.

hackernews.title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
hackernews.summary: Researchers found a gap in ChatGPT's authentication that allowed account takeover by manipulating math verification.
hackernews.why: A reminder to never trust client-side validation alone, especially for anything involving user sessions or payments.

x_posts.title: OpenAI Developers: GPT-6 Astra controls robot arm
x_posts.summary: OpenAI Developers shared an experiment where GPT-6 Astra remotely controlled a robot arm in the Scav robotics community.
x_posts.why: Physical-world agent control is a logical next frontier after desktop automation; watching Scav's experiments tells us what works.

x_posts.title: OpenAI Developers: Agents API updates this week
x_posts.summary: OpenAI announced Agents API updates this week.
x_posts.why: The Agents API is a potential alternative to our current DSPy and LangChain patterns for stateful workflows; worth tracking for Pipeline.

x_posts.title: Addy Osmani: Claude Code 'ultrathink' tip
x_posts.summary: Addy Osmani shared a Claude Code tip: typing 'ultrathink' mid-turn raises the effort level for the rest of that turn.
x_posts.why: A hidden steering command we can use when a task hits resistance; no need to cancel and rewrite the prompt.

x_posts.title: shadcn: Slack and Linear as AI harness UIs
x_posts.summary: shadcn predicts every AI harness will eventually build Slack and Linear UIs.
x_posts.why: We already see Slack as a control surface for Botterfly; Linear as a second interface would let the agent read, create, and move tickets.

closing: Research: no new papers in our categories in the arXiv overnight listing (feed rebuilt Nov 1, 2026).
